spec.description: An example dashboard for Longhorn. Updated by ONZACK AG (Robin Hermann)

panels.description: The total number of volumes in the Longhorn storage system state/conditionの0・1値を集計する。必要な系列がない場合はUnknown。
panels.title: Total Number Of Volumes

panels.description: Healthy volumes are volumes that are attaching to a node and have the number of healthy replicas equals to the expected number of replicas. state/conditionの0・1値を集計する。必要な系列がない場合はUnknown。
panels.title: Number Of Healthy Volumes

panels.description: Degraded volumes are volumes that have the number of healthy replicas smaller than the expected number of replicas. e.g. User creates a volume with 2 replicas but 1 replicas is failed. state/conditionの0・1値を集計する。必要な系列がない場合はUnknown。
panels.title: Number Of Degraded Volumes

panels.description: Fault volumes are volumes that doesn't have any healthy replica. state/conditionの0・1値を集計する。必要な系列がない場合はUnknown。
panels.title: Number Of Fault Volumes

panels.description: Attached volumes are volumes that are currently attaching to a node state/conditionの0・1値を集計する。必要な系列がない場合はUnknown。
panels.title: Number Of Attached Volumes

panels.description: Detached volumes are volumes that aren't currently attaching to a node state/conditionの0・1値を集計する。必要な系列がない場合はUnknown。
panels.title: Number Of Detached Volumes

panels.description: Longhornが報告するunknown状態。収集欠測とは別に数え、healthyへ含めない。 state/conditionの0・1値を集計する。必要な系列がない場合はUnknown。
panels.title: Unknown robustness

panels.description: Longhornのactual size / capacity。filesystemの使用量とは異なり、snapshot等を含む。
panels.title: Volume Actual Size

panels.description: 容量はLonghorn、Usedはkubeletのfilesystem使用量。kube-state-metricsの現在のPVC→PV対応でvolumeを結合する。未mountや統計欠測は空欄であり使用量0ではない。

targets.expr: max by (cluster,volume,pvc_namespace,pvc) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (cluster,namespace,persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{cluster="$cluster"}) * on(cluster,namespace,persistentvolumeclaim) group_left(volumename) max by (cluster,namespace,persistentvolumeclaim,volumename) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{cluster="$cluster",storageclass="longhorn"}),"volume","$1","volumename","(.*)"),"pvc_namespace","$1","namespace","(.*)"),"pvc","$1","persistentvolumeclaim","(.*)")) and on(cluster,volume) max by (cluster,volume,pvc_namespace,pvc) (longhorn_volume_capacity_bytes{cluster="$cluster",volume=~"${volume:regex}"})

100 * (max by (cluster,volume,pvc_namespace,pvc) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (cluster,namespace,persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{cluster="$cluster"}) * on(cluster,namespace,persistentvolumeclaim) group_left(volumename) max by (cluster,namespace,persistentvolumeclaim,volumename) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{cluster="$cluster",storageclass="longhorn"}),"volume","$1","volumename","(.*)"),"pvc_namespace","$1","namespace","(.*)"),"pvc","$1","persistentvolumeclaim","(.*)")) and on(cluster,volume) max by (cluster,volume,pvc_namespace,pvc) (longhorn_volume_capacity_bytes{cluster="$cluster",volume=~"${volume:regex}"})) / on(cluster,volume) max by (cluster,volume,pvc_namespace,pvc) (longhorn_volume_capacity_bytes{cluster="$cluster",volume=~"${volume:regex}"})

panels.title: Volume Capacity

panels.description: The total number of nodes in the Longhorn storage system state/conditionの0・1値を集計する。必要な系列がない場合はUnknown。
panels.title: Total Number Of Nodes

panels.description: Disabled nodes are nodes that are disabled by the user.  When users disable a node, Longhorn will not use the node's storage for replica scheduling. Note that Longhorn can still attach a volume to disabled nodes because the actual data of the volume could be on a different node. state/conditionの0・1値を集計する。必要な系列がない場合はUnknown。
panels.title: Number Of Disabled Nodes

panels.description: Schedulable nodes are nodes that Longhorn can use their storage for replica scheduling. state/conditionの0・1値を集計する。必要な系列がない場合はUnknown。
panels.title: Number Of Schedulable Nodes

panels.description: ready条件がfalseのノード数。ready系列数とLonghornのnode countが一致しなければUnknown。 state/conditionの0・1値を集計する。必要な系列がない場合はUnknown。

targets.expr: sum by(cluster) (1 - max by (cluster,node) (longhorn_node_status{cluster="$cluster",condition="ready"})) and on(cluster) (count by(cluster) (max by (cluster,node) (longhorn_node_status{cluster="$cluster",condition="ready"})) == on(cluster) max by (cluster) (longhorn_node_count_total{cluster="$cluster"}))

panels.title: Number Of Failed Nodes

panels.title: Disk Space Usage
